profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Courage of the First Legion
chars: Friendly DARK ANGEL units automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 12" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Fury of the Lion
chars: If your warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, friendly DARK ANGEL units within 6" add 1 to their Strength characteristic in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Huntsman
chars: Your Warlord can fire their Pistol, Rapid Fire and Grenade weapons at enemy CHARACTERS even if they are not the closest enemy model. In addition, whenever your Warlord piles in or performs a Heroic Intervention, they can move towards the closest enemy CHARACTER instead of the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: Master of Maneuvre
chars: You can re-roll the dice used to determine how far friendly DARK ANGELS units Advance or charge if they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Stubborn Tenacity
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord loses a wound. Add 1 to the result if your Warlord did not move during his last Movement phase. On a 6+ your Warlord does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Lightning fast reactions
chars: You can always choose to have your Warlord fight first in the Fight Phase, even if they didn't charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have similar abilities, then alternate units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Shoot and Fade
chars: Immediately after making a shooting attack apart from when firing Overwatch your Warlord can move as if it were the Movement phase. If it does, it must Advance as part of this move.

profiles.name: Princeps of Deceit
chars: If your Warlord has this trait, then at the start of the first battle round, but before the first turn has begun, pick up to three friendly DARK ANGELS infantry units that are on the battlefield. profiles.name: Master of the Vanguard
chars: Add 1" to the Movement characteristic of friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord. In addition, add 1 to advance and charge rolls for friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Stealth Adept
chars: Substract 1 from hit rolls that target your Warlord.

profiles.name: Target Priority
chars: Instead of shooting with your Warlord in your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 3" if it and one enemy unit that is visible to your Warlord. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that friendly unit that target that enemy unit.

profiles.name: Marksman's Honors
chars: The Damage characteristic of ranged weapons your warlord is armed with is increased by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed to hi rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by your warlord. This Warlord trait does not aply to Grenade weapons, but does apply to Chapter Relics.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Master of Timing

profiles.name: Burner of Worlds

profiles.name: Planetary Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Counterfire Master

profiles.name: Fortress Commander

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: Siege Breaker
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they declare a charge against a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Fortress Destroyer
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they target a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: 2. Conqueror of Worlds

If an enemy unit within range of the same objective marker has a similar ability, then the objective marker is controlled by the player who has the most models within range of it as normal.

profiles.name: Courage of the First Legion

profiles.name: Fury of the Lion
chars: If your warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, friendly DARK ANGEL units within 6" add 1 to their Strength characteristic in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Huntsman
chars: Your Warlord can fire their Pistol, Rapid Fire and Grenade weapons at enemy CHARACTERS even if they are not the closest enemy model. profiles.name: Master of Maneuvre

profiles.name: Stubborn Tenacity

profiles.name: Lightning fast reactions
chars: You can always choose to have your Warlord fight first in the Fight Phase, even if they didn't charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have similar abilities, then alternate units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Shoot and Fade

chars: If your Warlord has this trait, then at the start of the first battle round, but before the first turn has begun, pick up to three friendly DARK ANGELS infantry units that are on the battlefield. profiles.name: Master of the Vanguard
chars: Add 1" to the Movement characteristic of friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord. In addition, add 1 to advance and charge rolls for friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Stealth Adept
chars: Substract 1 from hit rolls that target your Warlord.

profiles.name: Target Priority
chars: Instead of shooting with your Warlord in your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 3" if it and one enemy unit that is visible to your Warlord. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that friendly unit that target that enemy unit.

profiles.name: Marksman's Honors
chars: The Damage characteristic of ranged weapons your warlord is armed with is increased by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed to hi rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by your warlord. This Warlord trait does not aply to Grenade weapons, but does apply to Chapter Relics.

chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

chars: You can re-roll one failed Reserve roll each turn.

chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord if targeting an Attacking unit that arrived as reinforcements this turn.

chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Counterfire Master

profiles.name: Fortress Commander

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Defender

profiles.name: Siege Breaker

profiles.name: Fortress Destroyer
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they target a BUILDING.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. profiles.name: Meltagun
chars: When resolving an attack with this weapon against a target that is within half range, roll two D6 when inflicting damage with it and discard one of the results.

rules.name: Combi Weapon

chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

rules.name: Combi Weapon
rules.text: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Plasma blaster (standard)
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you can shoot either the boltgun, the plasma blaster, or both. If you fire both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls made for this weapon. In either case, each time you fire the plasma blaster, choose either the standard or supercharge profile; if you roll any hit rolls of 1 when firing a supercharged plasma blaster, the bearer is slain after all the weapon’s shots have been resolved

profiles.name: Plasma blaster (supercharge)
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you can shoot either the boltgun, the plasma blaster, or both. If you fire both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls made for this weapon. In either case, each time you fire the plasma blaster, choose either the standard or supercharge profile; if you roll any hit rolls of 1 when firing a supercharged plasma blaster, the bearer is slain after all the weapon’s shots have been resolved

profiles.name: Plasma gun, Supercharge
chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

rules.name: Combi Weapon
rules.text: When attacking with this weapon, choose one or both of the profiles. If you choose both, subtract 1 from all hit rolls for this weapon.

profiles.name: Chainsword
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Power fist
chars: When attacking with this weapon, you must subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Lightning claw
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for this weapon. If a model is armed with two lightning claws, each time it fights it can make 1 additional attack with them.

profiles.name: Thunder hammer
chars: When attacking with this weapon, subtract 1 from the hit roll.

profiles.name: Heavenfall Blade
chars: Each time the bearer fights, it can make one additional attack with this weapon.

profiles.name: Monster Slayer of Caliban
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls targeting an enemy MONSTER or enemy VEHICLE

profiles.name: Mace of Redemption
chars: Re-roll all failed wound rolls made for this weapon against HERETIC ASTARTESunits

profiles.name: Shroud of Heroes
chars: Your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls that target the bearer.

profiles.name: The Eye of the Unseen
chars: Enemy units within 3" of the bearer must subtract 1 from their Leadership characteristic. In addition, enemy CHARACTERSthat start the Fight phase within 3" of the bearer can only be chosen to fight after all other eligible units have made their attacks, even if they charged or have an ability that would allow them to fight first.

profiles.name: Adamantine Mantle
chars: When a model with this Relic would lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Brilliant Strategist
chars: Once per battle, if your Warlord is on the battlefield you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged, roll a D6 each time you use a Stratagem; on a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: Courage of the First Legion
chars: Friendly DARK ANGEL units automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 12" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Fury of the Lion
chars: If your warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, friendly DARK ANGEL units within 6" add 1 to their Strength characteristic in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Huntsman
chars: Your Warlord can fire their Pistol, Rapid Fire and Grenade weapons at enemy CHARACTERS even if they are not the closest enemy model. In addition, whenever your Warlord piles in or performs a Heroic Intervention, they can move towards the closest enemy CHARACTER instead of the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: Master of Maneuvre
chars: You can re-roll the dice used to determine how far friendly DARK ANGELS units Advance or charge if they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Stubborn Tenacity
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord loses a wound. Add 1 to the result if your Warlord did not move during his last Movement phase. On a 6+ your Warlord does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Lightning fast reactions
chars: You can always choose to have your Warlord fight first in the Fight Phase, even if they didn't charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have similar abilities, then alternate units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Shoot and Fade
chars: Immediately after making a shooting attack apart from when firing Overwatch your Warlord can move as if it were the Movement phase. If it does, it must Advance as part of this move.

profiles.name: Princeps of Deceit
chars: If your Warlord has this trait, then at the start of the first battle round, but before the first turn has begun, pick up to three friendly DARK ANGELS infantry units that are on the battlefield. You can immediately remove these units from the battlefield and set them up again as described in the Deployment section of the mission you are playing (if both players have abilities that allow them to redeploy units, roll off and the winner chooses which player redeploys their units first)

profiles.name: Master of the Vanguard
chars: Add 1" to the Movement characteristic of friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord. In addition, add 1 to advance and charge rolls for friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Stealth Adept
chars: Substract 1 from hit rolls that target your Warlord.

profiles.name: Target Priority
chars: Instead of shooting with your Warlord in your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 3" if it and one enemy unit that is visible to your Warlord. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that friendly unit that target that enemy unit.

profiles.name: Marksman's Honors
chars: The Damage characteristic of ranged weapons your warlord is armed with is increased by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed to hi rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by your warlord. This Warlord trait does not aply to Grenade weapons, but does apply to Chapter Relics.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Master of Timing
chars: You can re-roll one failed Reserve roll each turn.

profiles.name: Burner of Worlds
chars: When you make Firestorm attacks, add 1 to the total number you can make.

profiles.name: Planetary Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Lord of Ambush
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord if targeting an Attacking unit that arrived as reinforcements this turn.

profiles.name: Planetary Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Counterfire Master
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord (this includes any BUILDING they are embarked within, and any other units embarked within the same building).

profiles.name: Fortress Commander
chars: If your Warlord is embarked within a BUILDING, roll a dice each time that building loses a wound; on a 6+, the building does not lose a wound.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: Siege Breaker
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they declare a charge against a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Fortress Destroyer
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they target a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: 1. Cityfight Specialist
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, you receive 3 additional Command Points. These can only be spent to use Cities of Death Stratagems (pg 32-35).

profiles.name: 2. Conqueror of Worlds
chars: If this Warlord is within range of an objective marker (see above) it controls that objective marker even if there are more enemy models within range of the same objective marker. If an enemy unit within range of the same objective marker has a similar ability, then the objective marker is controlled by the player who has the most models within range of it as normal.

profiles.name: 3. Urban Warrior
chars: This Warlord treats all soft cover it is entirely on or within, or that it is receiving the benefit of cover from, as hard cover (pg 30). In addition, enemy units do not receive the benefit to their saving throws for being in cover against attacks made by this Warlord.

profiles.name: Capacity
chars: This model can tranport 10 <CHAPTER> INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, TERMINATOR or PRIMARIS models.

profiles.name: Aquila aegis field
chars: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: Data augurs
chars: hen resolving an attack made with a ranged weapon by this model, if it is within 24" of any friendly Dark Angels Rhino Primaris models, add 1 to the hit roll.

profiles.name: Explodes
chars: If this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before removing the model from the battlefield; on a 6 it explodes, and each unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
chars: This model does not suffer the penalty to hit rolls for moving and firing Heavy weapons.

profiles.name: Smoke Launchers
chars: Once per game, a model equipped with smoke launchers can use them instead of shooting any weapons in the Shooting phase; until your next Shooting phase your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls for ranged weapons that target this vehicle.

profiles.name: Rites of Battle
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 made for friendly <CHAPTER> units within 6" of this model.

chars: On a hit roll of 1, the bearer is slain after all of this weapon's shots have been resolved.

profiles.name: Multi-melta

profiles.name: Jump Pack Assault
chars: During deployment, if this model has a jump pack, you can set it up high in the skies instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases this model can assault from above - set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 1) Mind worm
chars: If manifested, select an enemy unit within 12" of the psyker that is visible to him. That unit suffers a mortal wound and may only be chosen to fight in the Fight phase after all other eligible units have fought, even if they charged or have an ability that would allow them to fight first. This effect lasts until the end of your turn.

profiles.name: 2) Aversion
chars: If manifested, select an enemy unit within 24" of the psyker that is visible to him. Until your next Psychic phase, your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls made for that unit.

profiles.name: 3) Righteous Repugnance
chars: If manifested, pick a friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 12" of the psyker (if your psyker is from a Dark Angels successor Chapter, pick a friendly unit from that Chapter instead). You can re-roll all failed hit rolls and wound rolls made for the unit's Melee weapons until the start of your next Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 4) Trephination
chars: If manifested, roll 2D6, adding 2 to the total if the psychic test was more than 10. The closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers a mortal wound for each point the total exceeds their highest Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 6) Mind Wipe
chars: If manifested, choose an enemy model within 18" of the psyker that is visible to him. Each player then rolls a D6 and adds their model's Leadership characteristic to their result. If your opponent scores higher, or if the scores are drawn, nothing happens. If your score is higher, the enemy model reduces its Leadership, Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics by 1 for the rest of the battle.

profiles.name: 5) Engulfing Fear
chars: If manifested, until the start of your next Psychic phase, your opponent must roll 2 dice and discard the lowest result when taking Morale tests for any unit that is within 6" of the psyker.

profiles.name: Grav-pistol

profiles.name: 1) Mind worm
chars: If manifested, select an enemy unit within 12" of the psyker that is visible to him. That unit suffers a mortal wound and may only be chosen to fight in the Fight phase after all other eligible units have fought, even if they charged or have an ability that would allow them to fight first. This effect lasts until the end of your turn.

profiles.name: 2) Aversion
chars: If manifested, select an enemy unit within 24" of the psyker that is visible to him. Until your next Psychic phase, your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls made for that unit.

profiles.name: 3) Righteous Repugnance
chars: If manifested, pick a friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 12" of the psyker (if your psyker is from a Dark Angels successor Chapter, pick a friendly unit from that Chapter instead). You can re-roll all failed hit rolls and wound rolls made for the unit's Melee weapons until the start of your next Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 4) Trephination
chars: If manifested, roll 2D6, adding 2 to the total if the psychic test was more than 10. The closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers a mortal wound for each point the total exceeds their highest Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 6) Mind Wipe
chars: If manifested, choose an enemy model within 18" of the psyker that is visible to him. Each player then rolls a D6 and adds their model's Leadership characteristic to their result. If your opponent scores higher, or if the scores are drawn, nothing happens. If your score is higher, the enemy model reduces its Leadership, Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics by 1 for the rest of the battle.

profiles.name: 5) Engulfing Fear
chars: If manifested, until the start of your next Psychic phase, your opponent must roll 2 dice and discard the lowest result when taking Morale tests for any unit that is within 6" of the psyker.

profiles.name: Shroud of Heroes
chars: Your opponent must subtract 1 from all hit rolls that target the bearer.

profiles.name: The Eye of the Unseen
chars: Enemy units within 3" of the bearer must subtract 1 from their Leadership characteristic. In addition, enemy CHARACTERSthat start the Fight phase within 3" of the bearer can only be chosen to fight after all other eligible units have made their attacks, even if they charged or have an ability that would allow them to fight first.

profiles.name: Adamantine Mantle
chars: When a model with this Relic would lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ that wound is not lost.

profiles.name: 11: Inspirational Fighter
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Fight phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 12: Beast Hunter
chars: You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made by this model in the Fight phase if the target is a MONSTER unit.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic
chars: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention if, after the enemy has completed all of their charge moves, it is within 6" of any enemy units, and can move up to 6" when doing so.

profiles.name: 14: Duelist
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength and Attacks characteristics while it is within 1" of any enemy Character units.

profiles.name: 15: Zealot
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move, performed a Heroic Intervention, or was charged this turn.

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots
chars: Each wound roll of 6+ made for this model’s ranged attacks inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage.

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye
chars: This model can target enemy CHARACTER units in the Shooting phase even if they are not the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter
chars: When this model fires Overwatch, it successfully hits on rolls of 5 or 6, instead of only 6.

profiles.name: 31: Grudge
chars: You can re-roll any hit, wound and damage rolls made for this model’s attacks that target the enemy Warlord.

profiles.name: 32: Resilient
chars: Each time this model loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 5+ it does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage
chars: Add 2 instead of 1 to saving throws made for this model when it is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of your turn.

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. If your opponent has any units with similar abilities, roll off; starting with the winner of the roll-off, take it in turns to resolve these abilities.

profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader
chars: Friendly <Sub-faction>units can use this model’s Leadership instead of their own while they are within 6" of it.

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics
chars: This model, and friendly<Sub-faction>units within 6" of them, can charge even if they Fell Back that turn.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
chars: Each time you make a wound roll of 6+ in the Shooting phase for a friendly <Sub-faction>unit within 6" of this model, the AP characteristic of that attack is improved by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 02: Auto-loader
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Increase the number of shots this weapon makes by 1 (e.g. a Pistol 1 weapon becomes a Pistol 2 weapon).

profiles.name: 03: Penetrator Rounds
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 04: High Calibre
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add 6" to that weapon’s Range characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round
chars: Pick one of this model’s ranged weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Units do not receive the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each time the bearer fights, it can make 1 additional attack with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 09: Shredder
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘You can re-roll failed wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon.’

profiles.name: 10: Brutal
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s Strength characteristic by 1 (e.g. User becomes +1, +1 becomes +2).

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 12: Heirloom
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Add the following ability to that weapon: ‘Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for attacks with this weapon scores 2 hits instead of 1’.

profiles.name: 1: Psychic Might
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to manifest in your Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 2: Adamantium Will
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this character can attempt to deny in your opponent’s Psychic phase.

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore
chars: Add 1 to the number of psychic powers this model knows from one of the psychic disciplines available to them.

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Brilliant Strategist
chars: Once per battle, if your Warlord is on the battlefield you can re-roll a single hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged, roll a D6 each time you use a Stratagem; on a 5+ you gain 1 Command Point.

profiles.name: Courage of the First Legion
chars: Friendly DARK ANGEL units automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 12" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Fury of the Lion
chars: If your warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, friendly DARK ANGEL units within 6" add 1 to their Strength characteristic in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Huntsman
chars: Your Warlord can fire their Pistol, Rapid Fire and Grenade weapons at enemy CHARACTERS even if they are not the closest enemy model. In addition, whenever your Warlord piles in or performs a Heroic Intervention, they can move towards the closest enemy CHARACTER instead of the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: Master of Maneuvre
chars: You can re-roll the dice used to determine how far friendly DARK ANGELS units Advance or charge if they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Stubborn Tenacity
chars: Roll a dice each time your Warlord loses a wound. Add 1 to the result if your Warlord did not move during his last Movement phase. On a 6+ your Warlord does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Lightning fast reactions
chars: You can always choose to have your Warlord fight first in the Fight Phase, even if they didn't charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have similar abilities, then alternate units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: Shoot and Fade
chars: Immediately after making a shooting attack apart from when firing Overwatch your Warlord can move as if it were the Movement phase. If it does, it must Advance as part of this move.

profiles.name: Princeps of Deceit
chars: If your Warlord has this trait, then at the start of the first battle round, but before the first turn has begun, pick up to three friendly DARK ANGELS infantry units that are on the battlefield. You can immediately remove these units from the battlefield and set them up again as described in the Deployment section of the mission you are playing (if both players have abilities that allow them to redeploy units, roll off and the winner chooses which player redeploys their units first)

profiles.name: Master of the Vanguard
chars: Add 1" to the Movement characteristic of friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord. In addition, add 1 to advance and charge rolls for friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Stealth Adept
chars: Substract 1 from hit rolls that target your Warlord.

profiles.name: Target Priority
chars: Instead of shooting with your Warlord in your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 3" if it and one enemy unit that is visible to your Warlord. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that friendly unit that target that enemy unit.

profiles.name: Marksman's Honors
chars: The Damage characteristic of ranged weapons your warlord is armed with is increased by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed to hi rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by your warlord. This Warlord trait does not aply to Grenade weapons, but does apply to Chapter Relics.

profiles.name: Legendary Fighter
chars: If this warlord charges in the charge phase, add 1 to their attacks characteristic until the end of the ensuing fight phase.

profiles.name: Inspiring Leader
chars: Friendly units within 6" of this warlord can add 1 to their leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor
chars: Roll a dice each time this warlord loses a wound. On a 6, the warlord shrugs off the damage and does not lose the wound.

profiles.name: Master of Timing
chars: You can re-roll one failed Reserve roll each turn.

profiles.name: Burner of Worlds
chars: When you make Firestorm attacks, add 1 to the total number you can make.

profiles.name: Planetary Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Lord of Ambush
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord if targeting an Attacking unit that arrived as reinforcements this turn.

profiles.name: Planetary Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Planetstrike Stratagem.

profiles.name: Counterfire Master
chars: You can re-roll failed hit rolls for friendly units within 6" of your Warlord (this includes any BUILDING they are embarked within, and any other units embarked within the same building).

profiles.name: Fortress Commander
chars: If your Warlord is embarked within a BUILDING, roll a dice each time that building loses a wound; on a 6+, the building does not lose a wound.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Defender
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: Siege Breaker
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they declare a charge against a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Fortress Destroyer
chars: You can re-roll wound rolls of 1 for friendly units that are within 6" of your Warlord when they target a BUILDING.

profiles.name: Stronghold Assault Attacker
chars: You have one bonus Command Point – this can only be spent on a Stronghold Assault Stratagem.

profiles.name: 1. Cityfight Specialist
chars: If your army is Battle-forged, you receive 3 additional Command Points. These can only be spent to use Cities of Death Stratagems (pg 32-35).

profiles.name: 2. Conqueror of Worlds
chars: If this Warlord is within range of an objective marker (see above) it controls that objective marker even if there are more enemy models within range of the same objective marker. If an enemy unit within range of the same objective marker has a similar ability, then the objective marker is controlled by the player who has the most models within range of it as normal.

profiles.name: 3. Urban Warrior
chars: This Warlord treats all soft cover it is entirely on or within, or that it is receiving the benefit of cover from, as hard cover (pg 30). In addition, enemy units do not receive the benefit to their saving throws for being in cover against attacks made by this Warlord.

profiles.name: Smite
chars: If manifested, the closest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker suffers 1 mortal wound. If the result of the Psychic test was more than 10 the target suffers D3 mortal wounds instead.

profiles.name: Actinic Halo
chars: Lieutenant Commander Anton Narvaez has a 2+ invulnerable save. If he fails an invulnerable save in any phase, his invulnerable save for the rest of the game is now to 6+.

profiles.name: Rites of Battle (Marines Errant)
chars: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for friendly MARINES ERRANT units within 6" of Lieutenant Commander Anton Narvaez.

rules.name: Angels of Death
rules.text: This unit has the following abilities: And They Shall Know No Fear, Bolter Discipline, Shock Assault and Combat Doctrines.’

profiles.name: Voidshard power blade
chars: Any wound rolls of 6+ made for this weapon cause a single mortal wound instead of the normal damage.

profiles.name: Artisan of War
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of one weapon carried by your Warlord. Note that this cannot be a Relic of Baal.

profiles.name: Soulwarden
chars: You can attempt to resist one psychic power with your Warlord (or attempt to resist one additional psychic power if he is already able to do so) in each of your opponent's Psychic phases.

profiles.name: Heroic Bearing
chars: Friendly BLOOD ANGELS units automatically pass Morale tests whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Gift of Foresight
chars: Roll aD6 each time your Warlord loses a wound, re-rolling rolls of 1; on a 6, that wound is ignored and has no effect. If your Warlord also has the Black Rage ability, they instead ignore wounds on rolls of 5 or 6, but the similar ability to ignore wounds from the Black Rage has no effect.

profiles.name: Selfless Valour

chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of one weapon carried by your Warlord. Note that this cannot be a Relic of the Vigilant, and does not affect a weapon using the Banebolts of Eryxia

profiles.name: Lord of Hidden Knowledge
chars: Once per battle, if your Warlord is on the battlefield, you can re-roll a hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw. In addition, if your army is Battle-forged and your Warlord is on the battlefield, roll a D6 each time you use a Stratagem; on a 5+, you gain a Command Point.

profiles.name: Nowhere to Hide
chars: At the start of each of your Shooting phases, pick one enemy unit anywhere on the battlefield. For the duration of the phase, that unit does not receive the benefit of cover against attacks made by DEATHWATCH units from your army that are within 6" of your Warlord.

profiles.name: Vigilance Incarnate
chars: Once during the battle, at the start of your turn, you can choose to change your army’s current Mission Tactic (pg 94) for another one

profiles.name: Watch Eternal
chars: Roll a D6 each time a DEATHWATCH model from your army within 6" of your Warlord would lose their last wound. On a 6 the wound is not lost.

Deed of Legend: Slay the enemy Warlord with your Warlord.

chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks make by a unit affected by this saga that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE.  Deed of Legend: Slay and enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE with your Warlord.

profiles.name: Saga of the Hunter
chars: A unit affected by this saga in your Charge phase can charge even if it Advanced earlier in the turn.  Deed of Legend: Successfully charge an enemy unit with your Warlord.

profiles.name: 13: Heroic

profiles.name: 14: Duelist

profiles.name: 15: Zealot

profiles.name: 16: Deadly Charge
chars: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model in the Fight phase if it made a charge move this turn.

profiles.name: 21: Targeting Augury
chars: Enemy units do not gain the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made by friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model when the attack is made.

profiles.name: 22: Directed Fire
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for friendly <Sub-faction> units within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 23: Deadly Marksman
chars: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by this model.

profiles.name: 24: Sundering Shots

profiles.name: 25: Keen Eye

profiles.name: 26: Defensive Fighter

profiles.name: 32: Resilient

profiles.name: 33: Camoflage

profiles.name: 34: Stealth Assault
chars: Enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at this model.

profiles.name: 35: Indomitable
chars: All damage suffered by this model is halved (rounding up).

profiles.name: 36: Impervious

profiles.name: 41: Infiltrator
chars: During deployment, you can set up this model in ambush, instead of placing it on the battlefield. At the end of any of your Movement phases it can reveal its location – set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from any enemy models.

profiles.name: 42: Stealthy
chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill
chars: Wound rolls of 1, 2 or 3 made for attacks that target this model always fail, even if the attack has a Strength characteristic higher than this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 51: Inspirational Leader

profiles.name: 52: Rallying Cry
chars: You can re-roll failed Morale tests for friendly <Sub-faction>units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: 53: Icon of Retribution
chars: Roll a dice each time a friendly <Sub-faction>model within 6" of this model is slain in the Fight phase. On a 6, the unit that made the attack that slew the model suffers 1 mortal wound after it has finished making its attacks.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 3" of this model.

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: 61: Air Strike
chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 62: Swift Advance
chars: When this model Advances, add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase instead of rolling a D6

profiles.name: 63: Reactive Tactics

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire

profiles.name: 05: Improved Sights

profiles.name: 06: Inferno Round

profiles.name: 07: Artificer Weapon
chars: Pick one of this model’s weapons. Add 1 to that weapon’s Damage characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Finely Balanced

profiles.name: 09: Shredder

profiles.name: 11: Razor-edged
chars: Pick one of this model’s melee weapons. Improve that weapon’s AP characteristic by 1 (e.g. AP -1 becomes AP -2).

profiles.name: 3: Master of Lore

profiles.name: 02: Old War Wound
chars: Select a result from this table, or roll 2D6 to randomly select a result (re-roll if you get this result again). Subtract or worsen this model’s characteristic by the amount described in the result you picked instead of adding or improving it (e.g. if the Ferocious Combatant result was selected, an Attacks characteristic of 3 would become 2, while if the Dead-eyed result was selected, a BS of 3+ would become 4+)

profiles.name: 03: Courageous
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: 04: Ferocious Combatant
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Attacks characteristic.

profiles.name: 05: Mighty
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Strength characteristic.

profiles.name: 06: Dead-eyed
chars: Improve this model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. BS 3+ will become BS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 07: Fleet
chars: Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic.

profiles.name: 08: Blademaster
chars: Improve this model’s Weapon Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. WS 3+ will become WS 2+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 09: Enhanced Physiology
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Toughness characteristic.

profiles.name: 10: Toughened Armor
chars: Improve this model’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. Sv 5+ will become Sv 4+), to a maximum of 2+.

profiles.name: 11: Divine Protection
chars: Improve this model’s invulnerable save by 1 (e.g. an invulnerable save of 5+ will become an invulnerable save of 4+), to a maximum of 3+. If this model does not have an invulnerable save, it instead gains a 6+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: 12: Heroic Constitution
chars: Add 1 to this model’s Wounds characteristic.

profiles.name: Fury of the Lion
chars: If your warlord charged, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, friendly DARK ANGEL units within 6" add 1 to their Strength characteristic in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: Huntsman
chars: Your Warlord can fire their Pistol, Rapid Fire and Grenade weapons at enemy CHARACTERS even if they are not the closest enemy model. profiles.name: Stubborn Tenacity

chars: You can always choose to have your Warlord fight first in the Fight Phase, even if they didn't charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have similar abilities, then alternate units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

chars: If your Warlord has this trait, then at the start of the first battle round, but before the first turn has begun, pick up to three friendly DARK ANGELS infantry units that are on the battlefield. chars: Add 1" to the Movement characteristic of friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your Warlord. In addition, add 1 to advance and charge rolls for friendly DARK ANGELS units whilst they are within 6" of your warlord.

profiles.name: Stealth Adept
chars: Substract 1 from hit rolls that target your Warlord.

profiles.name: Target Priority
chars: Instead of shooting with your Warlord in your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly DARK ANGELS unit within 3" if it and one enemy unit that is visible to your Warlord. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that friendly unit that target that enemy unit.

profiles.name: Marksman's Honors
chars: The Damage characteristic of ranged weapons your warlord is armed with is increased by 1. In addition, you can re-roll failed to hi rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by your warlord. This Warlord trait does not aply to Grenade weapons, but does apply to Chapter Relics.

profiles.name: Tenacious Survivor

profiles.name: Siege Breaker

chars: If this Warlord is within range of an objective marker (see above) it controls that objective marker even if there are more enemy models within range of the same objective marker. If an enemy unit within range of the same objective marker has a similar ability, then the objective marker is controlled by the player who has the most models within range of it as normal.

chars: This Warlord treats all soft cover it is entirely on or within, or that it is receiving the benefit of cover from, as hard cover (pg 30). In addition, enemy units do not receive the benefit to their saving throws for being in cover against attacks made by this Warlord.

profiles.name: Inner Circle

profiles.name: Iron Halo
chars: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

profiles.name: Concealed Position

profiles.name: Omni-scramblers

profiles.name: Rites of Battle

chars: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons that target this model.

profiles.name: 43: Hard to Kill

profiles.name: 44: Strategic Feint
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can pick a friendly <Sub-faction> unit within 6" of this model and set it up again, anywhere wholly within your deployment zone. profiles.name: 45: Swift Strike
chars: You can always choose this model to fight first in the Fight phase even if it did not charge. If the enemy has units that have charged, or that have a similar ability, alternate choosing units to fight with, starting with the player whose turn is taking place.

profiles.name: 46: Foresight
chars: Once per battle, if this model is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll, damage roll or saving throw.

profiles.name: 54: Impetuous
chars: You can re-roll failed charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: 55: Terrifying

profiles.name: 56: Savage Riposte
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made the attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

chars: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, you can pick an enemy unit, other than a Characterunit, that is visible to this model and roll a D6. On a 1-4 nothing happens. On a 5+ the target unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 64: Strike and Fade
chars: After this model has fought in the Fight phase, it can immediately pile in D3+3" in any direction, not just towards the closest enemy model.

profiles.name: 65: Final Strike
chars: If this model is slain, you can select an enemy unit within 3" of it and roll a D6; on a 2+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

profiles.name: 66: Direct Fire
